togglePoliceLights.onDown: if not gameplay_policeControls then extensions.load('gameplay_policeControls') end if gameplay_policeControls then gameplay_policeControls.togglePoliceLights() end
togglePoliceLights.title: Police: Toggle Lights
togglePoliceLights.desc: Toggle police lightbar lights only (siren remains off unless enabled separately)

anprNextEntry.onDown: if gameplay_policeComputer and (not gameplay_police or not gameplay_police.isStopActionMenuOpen or not gameplay_police.isStopActionMenuOpen()) then gameplay_policeComputer.cycleANPR(1) end
anprNextEntry.title: Police: ANPR Next Entry
anprNextEntry.desc: Cycle to the next entry in the ANPR scanned plates list

anprPrevEntry.onDown: if gameplay_policeComputer and (not gameplay_police or not gameplay_police.isStopActionMenuOpen or not gameplay_police.isStopActionMenuOpen()) then gameplay_policeComputer.cycleANPR(-1) end
anprPrevEntry.title: Police: ANPR Previous Entry
anprPrevEntry.desc: Cycle to the previous entry in the ANPR scanned plates list

confirmTrafficStopPrompt.onDown: if gameplay_police and gameplay_police.confirmTrafficStopPrompt then gameplay_police.confirmTrafficStopPrompt() end
confirmTrafficStopPrompt.title: Police: Confirm Traffic Stop
confirmTrafficStopPrompt.desc: Confirm the traffic stop on a fleeing vehicle.

toggleTrafficStopActionMenu.onDown: if not gameplay_policeControls then extensions.load('gameplay_policeControls') end if gameplay_policeControls then gameplay_policeControls.toggleTrafficStopActionMenu() end
toggleTrafficStopActionMenu.title: Police: Toggle Stop Action Menu
toggleTrafficStopActionMenu.desc: Open or close the traffic stop action menu when a full stop is active.

cancelTrafficStopActionMenu.onDown: if not gameplay_policeControls then extensions.load('gameplay_policeControls') end if gameplay_policeControls then gameplay_policeControls.cancelTrafficStopActionMenu() end
cancelTrafficStopActionMenu.title: Police: Cancel Stop Action Menu
cancelTrafficStopActionMenu.desc: Close the traffic stop action menu without selecting an action.

stopActionMenuStickX.onChange: if gameplay_police and gameplay_police.onStopMenuStickInput then gameplay_police.onStopMenuStickInput('x', VALUE) end
stopActionMenuStickX.title: Police: Stop Menu Stick X
stopActionMenuStickX.desc: Analog left/right stick input for the traffic stop action menu.

stopActionMenuStickY.onChange: if gameplay_police and gameplay_police.onStopMenuStickInput then gameplay_police.onStopMenuStickInput('y', VALUE) end
stopActionMenuStickY.title: Police: Stop Menu Stick Y
stopActionMenuStickY.desc: Analog up/down stick input for the traffic stop action menu.

cyclePoliceSiren.title: Police: Cycle Siren
cyclePoliceSiren.desc: Single tap cycles police siren tones while lights are on. Double tap turns the siren off.
